name: AutoXpose
description: Label a container, and AutoXpose builds the DNS record and reverse proxy for it.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with your provider settings and exposed services.

paths.name: Docker.Sock
paths.description: Read-only access to Docker, used to find other containers and read their autoxpose labels.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: AutoXpose web interface, published on host as 6103.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SERVER_IP
variables.description: Your public IP address or hostname. AutoXpose points new DNS A records at it. Replace CHANGEME_PUBLIC_IP before you install.

variables.name: LAN_IP
variables.description: The local IP address of your MOS box, like 192.168.1.10. Your reverse proxy sends traffic here. Replace CHANGEME_LAN_IP before you install.
